Complained to the manager--chandresh-- who was not trained well enough to address the situation.

After charging so exhorbitantly( for just popcorn, coffee n samosas )---it is a shame that such sub standard food is served to patrons. I am a very tolerant person,  and rarely complain--but this was too much of cheating of customers.

Truly upset and disappointed with PVR.  The relevant authorities need to check their kitchen.  Been to many PVR  theaters before,  including this one---and although the food was never great, it was atleast not so blatantly bad.

featured_reviews.name: Pooja K
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Citylight Cinema for a Sunday evening show recently. Overall, the theatre experience was actually not bad. For around ₹400, we got two tickets for a weekend evening show, which felt quite reasonable. The theatre was also pretty packed, so clearly a lot of people visit this place regularly.

The main disappointment was the food section. They had a large variety of items displayed on the menu screens, but most of them were not available. Only popcorn, samosas, nachos, and a paneer tikka sandwich were being served. Nothing else from the menu seemed available.

If you’re displaying so many food options, especially during a busy weekend evening show when people are likely to snack more, the counters should be better stocked. It creates unnecessary disappointment when customers see multiple items advertised but can’t actually order them.

Overall: decent theatre experience and fair ticket pricing, but the food availability definitely needs improvement.

featured_reviews.name: Sureshkumar Nagarajan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited PVR LIDO Juhu for the first time on 21st Sept 2025 to watch "The God Father" Rerelease!

This property is easy to navigate and it is just right on the main road side.

Really impressed with the colourful entrance. Though it is a smaller in size, but the aesthetical looks stunned me.
It given me dazzling bollywood look and feel!!
The Lobbies from main entrance to each theatres are featuring great interiors 👍👍

This property has 3 screens. While screen 1 and 2 are compact theatres, Screen 3 is a bit bigger.

Seatings are at top most comfort with food tray attached to each seat. Each row has big legroom.

Provided Screen size is maximum with respect to Auditorium size is a big plus.

They equipment Atmos system for even these small auditorium. Only drawback in Audio during my show was there was a beep sound making noise in the background.

Projection clarity is too good.

Airconditioning was just right.

Wash rooms are well installed and maintenaned.

Free drinking water facility is good and appreciable.

F&B items prices are high as usual for a PVR cinema.

Major drawback in this entire premises is Low Mobile Network.

Overall it is a nice and different cinema experience in PVR LIDO. Be prepared to watch movie here in a compact sized Theatres. If you come with an expectation of bigger screen experience, PVR LIDO may disappoint you.
Good idea to bring kids to this theater!!!

I have decided that I shall either not return to this place or, if I have no other choice, I'll wear ear plugs to muffle the decibel level. Patrons may not realise now, but listening to such high volumes over even a short duration, can and will make one lose their hearing faculty.
This is very serious and ALL CINEMA HALLS SHOULD HAVE A DECIBEL MEASURING SYSTEM IN PLACE.
I KNOW WHAT IT IS TO HAVE A HEARING IMPAIRMENT. My son is hearing impaired.

DO NOT RISK YOUR EARS by allowing cinema halls to force you to listen to such high volumes

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review to document a serious food safety incident at PVR, Jio World Plaza, BKC.

On 15 January 2026, I attended the 6:00 PM show of Avatar 3 in Audi 6. Before the movie, I purchased food from the PVR counter. While eating it during the show, the final bite contained a visible piece of glass that entered my mouth. I immediately spat it out. The fact that I was not physically injured was purely a matter of luck, this could have caused severe internal injury or worse.

I have video evidence clearly showing the glass shard in the food.

What has been equally disturbing is the way this matter has been handled since. Despite multiple emails, follow-ups, and assurances that the issue was being taken seriously, there were significant delays, inconsistent communication, and ultimately a response stating that no lapse could be established at their end. The only gesture initially offered was complimentary movie tickets, which is entirely inappropriate for a life-threatening food safety incident.

As a paying customer, being exposed to such a risk and then experiencing weeks of delay and deflection has been deeply distressing. This review is being posted so that other patrons are aware and so that this concern is documented publicly after private escalation failed to lead to a responsible resolution.

I hope PVR reviews its food safety accountability and customer handling practices more seriously going forward.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Metro INOX Cinema, and my overall experience was extremely enjoyable and comfortable. This cinema hall perfectly blends a classic feel with modern movie-watching amenities, making it a great choice for both regular viewers and cinema lovers who appreciate a well-maintained theatre.

The screen and sound quality were excellent. The visuals were sharp, bright, and immersive, which made the movie even more engaging. The sound system was well balanced—loud enough to create impact without being overwhelming. Dialogues were clear, and background music and effects were crisp, enhancing the overall cinematic experience.

The seating arrangement deserves special mention. The seats were comfortable, well-spaced, and offered a clear view of the screen from almost every angle. Legroom was sufficient, allowing for a relaxed experience even during a long movie. The auditorium was clean and well maintained, which added to the comfort level.

The ambience of Metro INOX has a pleasant and premium feel. The lobby area was neat, organized, and not overly crowded. The lighting and interiors give a classy vibe, making the wait time before the show quite comfortable. Entry and exit were well managed, avoiding unnecessary rush or confusion.

Food and beverages were also satisfactory. The snacks counter offered the usual cinema favourites like popcorn, cold drinks, and nachos. While prices are on the higher side—as expected in multiplexes—the quality and freshness were good. The staff at the counter were polite and quick in handling orders, even during peak hours.

Another positive aspect was the staff behavior and overall management. The staff members were helpful, courteous, and ensured smooth operations throughout the show. Ticket checking, seating guidance, and cleanliness were handled efficiently. Restrooms were clean and well maintained, which is an important factor for any public place.

Overall, Metro INOX Cinema provides a reliable, comfortable, and enjoyable movie-watching experience. Whether you’re going for a weekend show with friends, a family outing, or a solo movie break, this place delivers on quality, comfort, and ambience. I would definitely recommend Metro INOX Cinema to anyone looking for a pleasant and hassle-free cinema experience.

featured_reviews.name: Faraz Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
PVR Dynamix Juhu is one of the most popular cinemas in the area and definitely offers a good overall movie experience. The location is very convenient, being inside Dynamix Mall above Shoppers Stop, which makes it easy to access and also provides plenty of options for food or shopping before and after a show. The ambience of the cinema is clean, modern and well maintained, giving a premium feel as soon as you step in. The staff are generally polite and helpful, managing crowds well even during busy showtimes. The washrooms and lobby are also kept tidy, which adds to the comfort of the visit.

The technical quality of the cinema is one of its strongest points. The picture quality is sharp, bright and clear, and the sound system really enhances the experience. Whether it is a Hollywood blockbuster or a Bollywood release, the visuals and audio make the screening immersive. The food and beverage options are also decent, with fresh popcorn, nachos and other standard cinema snacks available. Although the prices are on the higher side, the taste and presentation are satisfactory.

The only real drawback is the seating. While everything else matches a premium standard, the seats are not as comfortable as expected. They feel a little cramped, especially during long movies, and the legroom is limited. In some screens, the distance from the seats to the screen can also feel slightly awkward, making the viewing angle less comfortable if you are seated too close.

Overall, PVR Dynamix Juhu is a great place for a movie outing, with excellent sound, visuals, ambience and service. If the seating comfort improves, it would easily become one of the best cinema experiences in Mumbai. I would rate it 4 out of 5.

We recently visited PVR Icon at Phoenix Palladium Mall, Lower Parel to watch the intense and gripping film *Tere Ishq Mein*, and the overall experience turned out to be truly awesome. From the moment we entered, the theatre carried a premium feel that perfectly matched the high-octane mood of the movie. The cleanliness was impressive, with spotless floors, fresh seats, and a well-maintained auditorium that immediately made us comfortable.

The atmosphere was classy and inviting, exactly what one expects from an ICON-format cinema. The lighting, décor, and overall layout added a modern, upscale touch to the outing. The sound quality was excellent, enhancing every emotional beat and intense moment of Tere Ishq Mein, Dialogues were crisp, background score was immersive, and the action-heavy scenes carried real impact. The seats were comfortable, spacious, and well-cushioned, allowing us to enjoy the long movie without any discomfort.

What added to the joy was that it was a perfect Sunday outing. After the movie, we explored Phoenix Palladium — always lively, beautifully maintained, and full of great options for shopping and food. Being from North India, we naturally gravitated to Punjab Grill for lunch, and it turned out to be a wonderful choice. The food was rich, flavourful, and truly reminded us of home. The combination of delicious North Indian dishes and the mall’s vibrant ambience made the outing even more memorable.

In short, our visit to PVR Icon at Phoenix Palladium was a fantastic experience. The movie was intense, the theatre offered top-notch comfort and quality, and the day ended perfectly with a satisfying meal and a relaxed stroll through the mall. A Sunday well spent.

For a change of pace and to explore something new, I caught a late-night movie at the PVR ICON (with Dolby Atmos) in Phoenix Palladium Mall, Lower Parel. It was a fantastic deal!
From the spacious lobby to the neat and well-maintained theatre, this place really stands out compared to other PVR locations I've visited. They offer a great variety of food items and excellent coffee options.
The seating—from sofa-style loungers to premium theatre seats—felt more like luxury, and in some ways, it was even better than the Gold Class Premier screens at other PVRs.
One standout observation: the sound engineer must be incredibly skillful. This delivered the best audio experience I've ever had in a PVR theatre—the Dolby Atmos immersion was top-notch!
Highly recommended place for anyone looking for a premium movie outing. Definitely worth it!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have visited the IMAX screen for Disclosure Day on 12th June 2026. While the screen is amazing, it is not wheelchair accessible at all. As a keen movie person and fan of the IMAX experience, I did book the middle row middle seats. However, even the aisle seats / bottom row seats / top row seats were not accessible.

I had to be carried by the staff, and had to wait for a very long time after the movie to be taken back to my wheelchair.
Kindly note that I had flown in from Bangalore to Mumbai to experience the movie here. However, it ended up as an exhausting experience. PVR theatres in Bangalore atleast have a hydraulic lift wheelchair that goes on staircases to support people with disabilities to sit on any seat.
Mumbai PVR and especially Phoenix Lower Parel is just horrible for accessibility.

I like your screen, and wish to come again. Please do something and accomodate me. Please take the necessary measure to be more inclusive in practice than just on paper!
